The connection between the screen unit and the keyboard unit (the hinge) lacks clear mechanical detail. It appears as a smooth, continuous blend rather than distinct interlocking parts, suggesting slight geometric ambiguity.
The buttons on the right side of the screen bezel have soft, undefined edges and lack the crisp separation from the casing typical of physical hardware buttons.
